retrieval_query_policy: same task text for both retrieval methods; no choices or answer key
scope: Diagnostic under incomplete ingestion; shared graph objects touched during failed attempt. No clean product ranking. Historical source texts and raw responses are withheld. No training or neighbor/format ablation.
controls: none and full-record conditions reused from earlier same-case/same-reader/same-seed trials
scoring: Predefined expected action index; malformed finish JSON counts as incorrect. Tools are simulated reads, not real operational actions.
